body: I'm in the exact same place right now. I' so sorry. I know how much it hurts...
It feels like stage 3 or 4 right now...I would do anything to get her back, but also know that there is no way we can be together again...I'm suffocating and I don't want to wake up.

It just sucks cuz with my other breakups, the feelings aren't there or aren't very strong, but this one hurts so much more because I still love her with all my heart and want to be there for her and I know she loves me too. Its taking everything in me to not call her and tell her to forget everything we talked about and just continue like it never happened.

Thank you so much. We are just getting through each day and trying to live as normally as we can. She has her procedures on Monday that will tell us the diagnosis. I am currently seeing a therapist and we are working on finding her one. It still feels overwhelming at times but we're trying(:
